{SAY:zombossicon}Do you like these creatures merely because they are able to assist you, or out of the kindness of your hearts?
{SAY:zombossicon}The choice is yours! Time is ticking!
{NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, much like last time, these Homing Thistles are put in another disadvantageous circumstance.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ENDANGERED_05_INTRO: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:winnie}More bells, you know what that means...
{SAY:winnie}Jesters, User Dave. They are back to harm our captured plants.
{SAY:winnie}It seems as if Zomboss is trying to make us all dislike the prospect of using plants as allies.
{SAY:winnie}He put them into these unfortunate scenarios to prove a sadistic point.
{TIRED:winnie}But we must not let these fabricated situations alter our resolve or prove him right.
{SAY:winnie}Precisely. AND he's endangering innocent plants to do it.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ENDANGERED_06_INTRO: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}I know deep down you're all hypocrites!
{SAY:zombossicon}Let's see if your very own allies sabotaging one another does the trick! Mwahahaha!
{SAY:winnie}I detect high levels of anger, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ENDANGERED_06_OUTRO: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Fantastic work, now we just have two batches of plants left to save.
{TIRED:crazydave}Boss Man's gonna see! We aren't lying!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ENDANGERED_08_INTRO: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I have located the last group of captured plants.
{EXCITED:crazydave}Let's get them saved and show him what's what!
{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Not so fast you time traveling twerps!
{SAY:zombossicon}I see my brilliantly devised traps have failed in hampering your resolve, but this shall not!
{SAY:zombossicon}You two are not ready for this, shall I say... GRIM situation...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ENDANGERED_08_OUTRO: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Curses! You really DO care for these horrid things!
{SAY:zombossicon}I guess I should've expected as much! I'll return, you cretins!
{NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}We have saved the Pepper-pults and Grimrose. Let the party commence.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GEMJAM_10_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Those gems are so close I can smell 'em!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GEMJAM_1_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Attention, User Dave! I have audio-detected a large stash of zombie gems.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GEMJAM_1_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}If we move swiftly, we may be able to claim them for our own.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GEMJAM_6_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}The zombies are aware of our gem quest, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GEMJAM_6_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}They intend to attack us from the sea.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GEMJAM_6_INTRO_3: {SAY:crazydave}We'll sea about that! Bowling Bulbs, LET'S ROLL!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GIRA_WEATHER_1_INTR: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Penny, help! There's sand in my eyes! Where are we?!
{SAY:zombossicon}With the power of my new storm machines, I have full control over the environment!
{SAY:zombossicon}Here in Egypt, your silly plants will be no match for the sandstorm! Muah-hah-hah-ha!
{NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I suspect we will have to travel through previous worlds to shut down the storm machines.
{SAY:winnie}My calculations show that they can affect either plants or zombies. We must remain vigilant.
{SAY:crazydave}Can you turn on your washer fluid? My eyes need cleaned out!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GIRA_WEATHER_4_INTR: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}What's with the weird big thingamajig on the lawn?
{SAY:winnie}That is a Gargantuar podium, User Dave.
{SAY:winnie}My research tells me the trap tile may spawn a Gargantuar out of the podium.
{SAY:winnie}Unlike previous trap tiles we've encountered, plants can't trigger these.
{SAY:crazydave}Wait, Penny, how much do plants even weigh?
{TIRED:winnie}Well, User Dave, if you insist... a Peashooter weighs around 6.45382 ounces.
{TIRED:winnie}A Sunflower is 3.34677 ounces, Wall-nuts are 10.22186 ounces, Chompers are 9.44376....
{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}I don't have the time for this! We're on a tight budget - get moving!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GIRA_WEATHER_8_INTR: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}It's so misty and moisty and munchalicious here!
{SAY:winnie}My readings indicate that zombies here won't be visible due to the misty terrain.
{SAY:crazydave}This place gives me the ghouls with these invisible fellows!
{TIRED:winnie}Invisi-ghoul is not a word, User Dave.
{EXCITED:crazydave}Whaaaaaattt?! Next you're gonna tell me munchalicious isn't a word either!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GOLDBLOOM_1_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}My sensors register a plant lost in time.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GOLDBLOOM_2_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Our missing plant is the Gold Bloom, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GOLDBLOOM_2_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}It produces an immediate bounty of sun when planted!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GOLDBLOOM_2_INTRO_3: {SAY:crazydave}Instant sun? Not good enough! MUST GO FASTER!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GOLDBLOOM_2_OUTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}The Gold Bloom is unstuck in time, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GOLDBLOOM_2_OUTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}Luckily I can track it whenever it goes.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GOLDBLOOM_7_OUTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}We did it! I am a hero to all plants!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GOLDBLOOM_7_OUTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}I am concerned about the strange portals we encountered, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GOLDBLOOM_7_OUTRO_3: {SAY:winnie} I believe some unfortunate chicanery may be afoot.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_01_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}I smell magic! And something rather unpleasant as well!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_01_2: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, that would be the plant we must rescue: Imp Pear.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_01_4: {SAY:winnie}Imps who consume Imp Pears will release gas due to indigestion.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_01_5: {TIRED:crazydave}And I thought stale milk was bad.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_01_6: {SAY:winnie}Regardless, we must rescue the Imp Pear for our collection.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_01_7: {TIRED:crazydave}I'm not letting him near my fridge.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_03_2: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, the Imp Pears are in danger. We must protect them.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_03_3: {SAY:winnie}My processors detect that these Imp Pears are all on the same type of Power Tile.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_03_4: {SAY:winnie}Feeding Imp Pears Plant Food will turn groups of zombies into Imps.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_03_5: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}That'll just make the lawn all funky smelling!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_04_2: {SAY:crazydave}At least they can't make this place smell any worse!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_04_3: {EXCITED:winnie}We now have a way to combat the Evil Potions.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_04_4: {EXCITED:winnie}Boosted zombies that consume Imp Pears lose their boost effects.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_04_5: {EXCITED:crazydave}Huh. Maybe these little stinkers ain't so bad after all!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_05_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}I've discovered a brand new species! Imp Pears!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_05_2: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:winnie}User Dave, have you even paid attention once throughout this adventure?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_05_3: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}These little buggers can take out hordes of critters!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_05_5: {TIRED:winnie}User Dave, I don't believe there were any squirbos in the Dark Ages...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_05_6: {EXCITED:crazydave}Speaking of those darned squirbos, here come the zombies!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_07_1: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Well, well, well, look who's meddling with my plants again!
{SAY:zombossicon}Oh, is that so? Tell me, have you seen your precious zombifying pears?
{EXCITED:crazydave}Hey, wait a darn second. Where are they? They're all gone!
{SAY:zombossicon}Precisely! You can have fun with these "Imp Pears" in the meantime! Muah-hah-hah!
{NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{TIRED:winnie}Calculations point to none of this making sense.
{TIRED:crazydave}And I'd just started to like the little fella...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_07_2: {SAY:zombossicon}Do you really think that Imp Pear is on your side?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_07_3: {SAY:zombossicon}Just look at his face! Can you really trust the face of an Imp?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_07_4: {SAY:zombossicon}An agent who will turn against you at the snap of my fingers!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_07_6: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Hey, Mr. Boss Guy, what's your opinion of Imp Pears?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_07_7: {SAY:zombossicon}I'm not being paid enough for this...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_07_9: {SAY:winnie}Your word cannot be trusted, Zomboss! You have lied too many times in the past!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_08_I: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}User Dave, I think I know what happened to our Imp Pears!
{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Ah, great! The mind of the operation has figured it out!
{SAY:zombossicon}I've experimented with your gross pears, and have made great breakthroughs with their properties!
{SAY:zombossicon}In the process, however, I have created... some really awful things.
{SAY:zombossicon}...and I don't want them in my lab, so I'm sending them to thwart you!
{SAY:zombossicon}If I had a nickel for Imp-related amalgamations I've created... I'd have two nickels currently.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_08_O: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:winnie}User Dave, how come you've grown to like Imp Pears so much?
{EXCITED:crazydave}Anything's good compared to those freakish imp things!
{SAY:winnie}I would indeed like to avoid facing such amalgamations again, User Dave.
{SAY:crazydave}Now that Imp Pear's rescued, we can go squirbo hunting!
{NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Oh, just you wait! I've saved my most important breakthrough for later...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}Camo, we're leading a full-frontal assault on your rocket today!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}You're not the only one with tricks up your sleeve.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_INTRO_12: {EXCITED:crazydave}That's right! And this is what heroes do to villains!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_INTRO_14: {SAY:captaincamo}I don't know if you nincompoops realize...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_INTRO_18: {TIRED:captaincamo}Ugh. Gotta ease up on the shouting.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:crazydave}Yeah! We can't let you get rid of the moon!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_INTRO_4: {SAY:captaincamo}My troops are already juiced up on every bit of radiation left on this rock.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_INTRO_5: {SAY:captaincamo}And your plants are now the ones playing dress up.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_INTRO_6: {SAY:captaincamo}So how are you exactly planning on taking me down?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_INTRO_7: {SAY:crazydave}You've clearly never read a comic book.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}Plus, we've got every heroic plant you can ask for in our arsenal.
